scope: Akhisar Museum’s mapped single-storey exhibition building as photographed in February 2025, including its north entrance canopy and glazed doorway, cream scored walls, brown tiled upper band, flat parapet roof and low entrance steps. The separately mapped administration building, storehouse, outer gate and garden exhibits are excluded.

primaryWrittenSource.facts: The museum’s exhibition building is described as one storey. The former Ali Şefik School was adapted for the museum. Written facts only.
